d: Platinum blonde hair is short, slicked back with a few loose strands falling over the forehead. One visible eye is a pale icy blue with a sharp, narrowed expression; the face appears mature and middle-aged with a lean, athletic build. The outfit consists of a dark blue high-collared garment layered under a heavy white fur-lined cloak. A black fabric eyepatch with a small metallic red and blue ornament covers one eye.
